create_layoutpredictor: create a LayoutPredictor instance with artifact path, device, and number of threads for document layout inference
test_layoutpredictor: test the LayoutPredictor class by initializing it and running predictions on PIL images and numpy arrays
run_predict_pil: run layout prediction on a PIL Image input and iterate over detected bounding boxes with labels and confidence scores
run_predict_numpy: run layout prediction on a numpy array input and iterate over detected bounding boxes with labels and confidence scores
get_predictor_info: get the LayoutPredictor configuration info including device, number of threads, image size, and threshold
